scenario: A residential utility customer submits a medical-hardship shutoff hold request, providing a hardship application form and a physician certification PDF. The agent extracts the medical entities from the submitted documents, evaluates eligibility against the state PUC winter moratorium and medical-hardship rules, and produces a formal protection-determination letter (Grant or Deny).
info_flow: medical-entity-extractor parses the physician certification text and hardship form to produce structured medical entities (diagnoses, equipment dependencies, conditions) → presale-regulation-auditor evaluates those entities against PUC eligibility rules to produce an eligibility determination record → reporting formats the determination into a customer-facing protection letter.
